title: Subset Sum in time O(2^{0.4877n})
summary: We present a uniform randomized classical algorithm for Subset Sum with running time O(2^{0.4877n}) in the word-RAM model, for inputs whose integer bit lengths are polynomially bounded in the number n of input integers. The algorithm halts on every execution and answers correctly with probability at least 2/3. The construction builds on OpenAI’s “Subset Sum in Time O(2^{0.49n})” (4 October 2026), retaining its framework of isolation, a capped preliminary search, a modular checksum, and alias subtraction.
